text:
Emma Chen: Heads-up — preparing rc-2 for tonight's change window (23:00 PT). I pushed release notes to drafts, but compliance flagged an artifact provenance mismatch and a license ambiguity in the SBOM. Can we triage quickly?

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Release blocked by gate 'provenance-audit' (artifact signed=false). SBOM license: ambiguous for 1 component. Logs: `provenance.check() -> FAIL (missing-signature)`

Ryan: On it. Which component is showing the ambiguity?

Maria P.: Looks like `thirdparty/fastparse` shows "UNKNOWN_LICENSE" in the generated SBOM. I pulled the tarball and its metadata shows a missing license field in package.json.

Olivia K.: compliance-bot already requested full sbom provenance + signing proof. We need either a quick sign from build system or an approved exception from security. Who can trigger a manual override if we can't get a rebuild?

Emma Chen: If rebuild within the window is unlikely, propose we delay the public rollout by one hour and ship internal canary to platform team. Otherwise we risk failing the release gate. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ryan: Quick patch option: pin that component to previous vetted digest (sha256:aa11...). That avoids a full rebuild. But need security approval to pin and waive the missing-signature check for one release.

Maria P.: I can prepare the pin PR now and update release notes with the mitigation footnote. PR will include `SBOM: pinned thirdparty/fastparse@sha256:aa11... — temporary pin pending license clarification`.

compliance-bot: Audit checklist requirement: for manual pin exception, provide (1) justification, (2) expected rollback plan, (3) who signed off. Stored in /audits/releases/2627723145. Automated retention note added.

Olivia K.: I'll take sign-off if security agrees to the pin path. Tagging @security on the PR will route to rotation.

Ryan: PR created: https://git.internal/release/rc-2-pin-2627723145. Includes release notes draft and rollback steps.

Emma Chen: OK, plan: (a) Maria merges pin PR, (b) Olivia/SEC sign-off by 22:45 PT, (c) we run a local signed artifact step and re-run deploy-bot checks. If sign-off misses, we delay public rollout + promote internal canary only.

Maria P.: Merging now.

deploy-bot: CI check: `sbom-validate` running... currently 12/12 checks passing except provenance. Re-run after merge.

Olivia K.: Security acked the PR in thread, leaving a short justification note. Signing now.

compliance-bot: Exception recorded: type=manual-pin, approver=Olivia K., ticket=INC-8892, expires=+7d.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: All gates passed after pin + signature. Release allowed for scheduled window. Canary promotion limited to 10% until 02:00 PT.

Emma Chen: Great work — I'll update release notes with the policy blurb and close the draft. Marking this as resolved for the window. :tada:
